neighbours.label: The single-letter token ' D' (also ' M') opening a proper name that the tokenizer splits after its first letter: D|ada, D|nieper, Queen M|ab
fire: The gallery devoted a whole floor to Dada and its Zurich founders.
Barges still carry grain along the Dnieper every autumn.
In the play, Mercutio gives a long speech about Queen Mab and her tiny coach.
The poet joined the Dada circle after moving to Paris.
The army crossed the Dnieper on rafts during the night.
Critics still argue about whether Dada was art or a protest against it.
The city stands on the right bank of the Dnieper above the rapids.
The fairy midwife of the dreamers is called Queen Mab in the old verse.
quiet: The gallery devoted a whole floor to Cubism and its Paris founders.
Barges still carry grain along the Rhine every autumn.
In the play, Mercutio gives a long speech about dreams and a tiny coach.
The poet joined the Surrealist circle after moving to Paris.
The army crossed the Danube on rafts during the night.
Critics still argue about whether Futurism was art or a protest against it.
The city stands on the right bank of the Volga above the rapids.
The fairy midwife of the dreamers is called Queen Titania by some readers.
